program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (bar-row (find-first (lambda (r)
                                       (for/or ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g r c) 1)))
                                     (range 0 h)))
                (markers (filter (lambda (c)
                                   (let ((v (at g bar-row c))) (and (!= v 0) (!= v 1))))
                                 (range 0 w))))
           (reduce (lambda (grid mc)
                     (let* ((color (at g bar-row mc))
                            (col-h (if (= color 8) 3 4))
                            (start-r (- bar-row col-h)))
                       (reduce (lambda (g2 dr)
                                 (let ((r (+ start-r dr)))
                                   (if (and (>= r 0) (< r bar-row))
                                       (set-cell g2 r mc (if (zero? dr) color 1))
                                       g2)))
                               grid
                               (range 0 col-h))))
                   g
                   markers))))
